text: Federal Reserve official Neel Kashkari stated that inflation control remained the central policy priority while describing the labor market as stable. Kashkari also questioned continued use of the Fed's dot-plot guidance framework under the new leadership of Chair Kevin Warsh. Inflation pressure remained linked to energy, fertilizer, and geopolitical supply conditions within Fed communications.

meta.note: Contest exists within communication architecture rather than current rate-policy direction.

text: Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee stated that energy inflation tied to the Iran conflict persisted longer than expected and described resulting conditions as stagflationary for energy-importing economies. Goolsbee also identified AI-linked equity appreciation, data-center investment, electricity demand, and construction costs as possible inflation-sensitive areas requiring observation within monetary policy assessment.

meta.note: Contingency applies to AI productivity effects remaining observational rather than realized.
